mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the two routes was most worthwhile because it showed the full journey from the right heart through the lungs, left heart and body, then back again.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the left-side valves repeated the same process as the right side, so those steps felt a little repetitive, even though their purpose was clear.

surprise.text: I was interested that blood inside the heart chambers cannot supply all of the thick heart muscle; the muscle needs its own vessels.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The valve slots and route pictures made the pairings understandable, and the final blood addition followed the stated goal.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the circulation connects to other body systems. The joined route was a useful payoff, although the repeated valve fittings were less engaging.
